question: What is the name of the border line between India and China?
solution:
The correct answer is __**McMahon Line**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **McMohan Line:**

 
 
• It is the borderline **between India and China.**__
 
• It is named after Sir Henry McMohan who was the Foreign Secretary of India and British mediator to decide this line.
 
• It was decided in the Shimla agreement (1914, between Britain and Tibet).
 
• India considers it a permanent national border, while China denies accepting it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
